VERIFIED: not an API resize artefact. claude-sonnet-5 is on the high-resolution tier (long edge 2576px, 4784 visual tokens), which downsizes only 74 of the 1272 images, and rescaling answers out of that frame gives 67.8%, slightly worse than leaving them alone; rescaling out of the standard 1568px frame gives 17.1%, which rules that tier out. Misses are wrong-element, not imprecise: median gap to the target box is 8.7% of the image diagonal and only 13.7% land within 50px. The weakness is by SOURCE, not resolution: 90.7% windows and 89.5% macos against 59.9% android, 62.4% ios and 42.7% gitlab. Comparability: Sonnet 5 has no published grounding figure. Claude models DO appear on ScreenSpot-Pro (Opus 4.8 87.9%, 4.6 83.1%, 4.5 45.7%) where they beat Qwen3-VL's self-reported 61.8-62.0%, but those runs permit cropping, visual search and planners by the leaderboard's own FAQ, while this row is bare single-turn. The ordering here is a property of the protocol, not a general capability claim. See docs/decisions/why-a-9b-outgrounds-the-frontier-model.md.

VERIFIED: not an API resize artefact. claude-sonnet-5 is on the high-resolution tier (long edge 2576px, 4784 visual tokens), which downsizes only 74 of the 1272 images, and rescaling answers out of that frame gives 67.8%, slightly worse than leaving them alone; rescaling out of the standard 1568px frame gives 17.1%, which rules that tier out. Misses are wrong-element, not imprecise: median gap to the target box is 8.7% of the image diagonal and only 13.7% land within 50px. The weakness is by SOURCE, not resolution: 90.7% windows and 89.5% macos against 59.9% android, 62.4% ios and 42.7% gitlab. Comparability: Sonnet 5 has no published grounding figure. Claude models DO appear on ScreenSpot-Pro (Opus 4.8 87.9%, 4.6 83.1%, 4.5 45.7%) where they beat Qwen3-VL's self-reported 61.8-62.0%, but those runs permit cropping, visual search and planners by the leaderboard's own FAQ, while this row is bare single-turn. The ordering here is a property of the protocol, not a general capability claim. See docs/decisions/why-a-9b-outgrounds-the-frontier-model.md.
